title: Self-supported Co3O4@Zn–CoNi2S4/NF core–shell nanoarrays as an efficient bifunctional electrode for overall water splitting
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,4848-4858
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09427E, Paper

Xuan Zhao, Yu Dong, Zhijie Wang, Yusheng Qiu, Ende Wang, Naikun Sun, Yongli Tong
This study reports the synthesis of self-supported Co3O4@Zn–CoNi2S4 core–shell nanoarrays on nickel foam as an efficient bifunctional electrocatalyst for overall water splitting.
